items.item: K3, the condition read in time (one page and overview, both languages)
items.how: One page (first run, checked): 'Read in time, it cannot hold over every step, since nothing reaches back; read from some step on, it holds exactly where, from any formation at any step, every formation is reached at some later step, through exchanges and each one's going on (07 §4.11)'. Chinese, K3's sentence verbatim: 按时间来读，它不能在每一步都成立，因为没有什么能到达过去；若从某一步起来读，它恰在这样的地方成立：从任一步的任一形成出发，经由交换与各自的延续，每一个形成都会在此后某一步被到达. Overview §7 'Read on relations' takes 07's full form: fails over every step wherever there is a formation, since nothing reaches an earlier step (`Flow.not_unrestricted_inTime`); its form from some step on, another predicate, holds exactly where the flow is mutually dependent in time, through exchanges and each one's going on, the steps reached differing (`Flow.unrestrictedEventually_iff_mutuallyDependentInTime`); over every later step it asks more (`Flow.unrestrictedAfter_iff_coupledEachStep`); `Drawing.lapses`. Overview table row: 'read in time, it cannot hold over every step, since nothing reaches back, and its form from some step on holds where …'. Chinese to match in both places. 'Over what comes after' is joined to none of these; it stays only in the one-center clause, naming «续无外于后»'s case (`TwoSources.apart`).

items.item: K4, the direction (one page's Alignment, overview §7, both languages)
items.how: One page: 'We offer AI a direction under the continuation condition, J1–J4 and a correspondence to actual systems; its theorems take J1/J2 and compare moves by what their outcomes admit, and do not use the condition; read under it, every admission compared counts from every standpoint (07 §7)'. Overview §7: 'The direction we offer AI is AI formation, learning, action and revision aligned with actual living and further generation within the whole. It is offered under …' in the same words. Chinese (astra's sentence): 以延续条件、J1–J4 以及与实际系统的对应为前提；其定理取 J1/J2，按各动作的结果所容纳者来比较诸动作，不使用延续条件；在该条件之下来读，所比较的每一项容纳从每一个立场看都算数. Checked against 07 §7's lead and its Conditional label as the ch07 agent left them.

English: 'On a fixed listing, self-concern and being increasing in admission coincide for every order exactly when every listed item is marked as one's own (`Weighting.increasingInOwn_iff_increasing_iff_marks`)'. The Chinese already had the quantifier where the Lean puts it (在一个固定列表上，自我关切与随容纳而递增对每一种次序都重合，恰在每个所列之物都被标记为自身之物之时); it keeps 重合 rather than K5's 相合 because this page names chapter 6's category of agreement *相合* (line 129), and the pin says so (see left).

items.item: K6, self-concern defined in the anchor's sentence (overview §7)
items.how: 'Call a life's order over courses *self-concerned* when it ranks above what it widens every widening that adds to its own continuation, read as what lies within its reach (*self-concern*, `Weighting.IncreasingInOwn`)', replacing 'Where a life holds its own continuation as an order over courses, …, that order is self-concern'. Chinese: 一个生命对诸进程的次序，若把每一个给自身的延续有所增加的扩大，都排在被它扩大者之上，就称为*自我关切*的；这里把自身的延续读作自身所能到达的一切, as README-ZH and GLOSSARY.zh say it. No quote of the old sentence was found outside dated review files.

items.item: K7, persisting without end with its hypotheses
items.how: Every 'never fits' on the four pages now carries 07 §4.9's hypotheses: the one page's how-far clause (as the screen places it) and its open-items bullet; the overview's table row, §7's ranking bullet and §10's open item. Chinese: 在 [07 §4.9] 所述的活动、支撑与世系假设之下 (one page's how-far, as the screen says it), 在 07 §4.9 所述的活动、支撑与世系假设之下 (overview table and §7), 在活动、支撑与世系这些假设之下 where the 07 §4.9 link follows at once (both open-items bullets); 世系 for descent as GLOSSARY.zh has it. A pin checks that every 'never fits' and every 列不进 on these pages has the hypotheses beside it.

items.how: Kept. It says 'from it we want to design an alignment in which people and AI, selecting together, fall into neither instrumental convergence nor the meta-attractor (below)'. The Alignment paragraph states the goal as GOALS#generative-alignment's objective does and then gives AJ's wording only as 'Its conditions', the goal's conditions with the plan named. The overview's lead and §7 are the same. No change.

items.item: The overview's one-center sentence (critic 5.2 item 11; overview row ~61, zh ~65)
items.how: The table row now says what the bound comes from on a net going forward in time: 'where it holds, on an acyclic relation every standpoint has the same center, on a net going forward in time because nothing other than the center may lie at or before the center's step, and over what comes after, two centers can meet it'. Chinese: 在随时间前进的网上，这是因为除中心之外，没有什么可以位于中心那一步或其前. §7's full form already had it (`«续无外当且仅当后与独»`, `«独则同一中心»`).

items.how: The table row that comes right after the in-time sentence now says 'where the condition, read across all steps, holds de se, an order ranking above what it widens …' (zh 在延续条件（跨越所有步来读）以从己方式成立之处). The in-time forms are other predicates, so this removes a doubt and does not change the claim. No pin or quote read the old words.
